title: Soft Dinner Rolls
description: Pillowy, buttery pull-apart dinner rolls made with instant yeast and brushed with melted butter as they come out of the oven.

image.alt: A pan of soft, shiny dinner rolls

steps.text: Stir the warm milk, yeast and sugar together in a large bowl. Add the egg, softened butter, flour and salt and mix into a soft dough.
Knead by machine on medium-low or by hand until smooth, elastic and just slightly tacky, {time 6-8 min}. Add flour a spoonful at a time only if it’s very sticky.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, {time 1 hr notimer}.

Butter the pan. Divide the dough into {count 12} pieces, roll each into a tight ball and set them in the pan in rows. Cover and let rise until puffy and touching, {time 30-40 min notimer}. Heat the oven to {temp 375F oven}.
Bake until golden brown and the center rolls read {temp 190F internal}, {time 18-22 min}. Brush with the melted butter right away.

notes: Make ahead: shape the rolls, cover and refrigerate overnight. Let them rise at room temperature for about an hour, then bake.
Baked rolls freeze for 3 months; warm them wrapped in foil.
